title: Contractible independence complexes of trees
summary: We show that the independence complex of a tree is contractible if and only if it can be reduced to a path \( P_n \) with \( n \equiv 1 \pmod{3} \) by a sequence of truncation moves at branching points. As a consequence of our method, we also characterize the trees for which the independence polynomial evaluated at \( -1 \) is equal to \( 1 \) or \( -1 \).
